title: iOS app tap · swipe · tree take tens of seconds — Maestro JVM starts per call
symptom: On an iOS simulator, app tap · swipe · tree take 20–50 s each or fail with 'maestro 응답 없음 (90초)' (maestro unresponsive, 90 s). On Android they take a few seconds
cause: simctl has no tap or screen-structure commands, so iOS control goes to Maestro, and a new Maestro (JVM) starts on every call. The per-action limit is 90 s. This is expected slowness, not a fault
fix: If you look → decide → tap many times, start the resident session first: launch_cli.py app session start --device <UDID> (then tree 0.6 s · tap 1 s)
Do not fire the same command again because it is slow — wait for the previous call to finish
To check the screen, add --shot to the action instead of calling shot: launch_cli.py app tap --device <UDID> --text <text> --shot <name>
Run long scenarios at once as the project's Maestro flow
